payload.title: Lab transformer C4: Catalog read robustness and write amplification
payload.description:
Preserve/log the underlying S3 error class in PayloadUnavailable (no secrets); one GET retry in the BFF; find and stop the whole-catalog snapshot rewrite storm (8,550 payload blobs / 11.19 GB since 2026-10-21T01Z, 1,000-2,172 commits/hour).
Acceptance: transient-error retry spec; typed cause for permanent failure; measured commit-rate baseline before/after.

Size: M
Dependencies: none
Epic: Lab is the single classifier per publication (decision-flywheel-1b8b860d). Related: hosted curation epic decision-flywheel-1da33407.

Approved by Ryan 2026-10-22; AWS changes need his explicit approval.
